units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Early|You've met the Coalition, and the Heliarchs that rule their space from within the ringworlds the Quarg built there who claim that they "defeated the Quarg oppressors." Would you like to look for some Quarg here and ask for their side of the story?|265|0
units.english: You've met the Coalition, and the Heliarchs that rule their space from within the ringworlds the Quarg built there who claim that they "defeated the Quarg oppressors." Would you like to look for some Quarg here and ask for their side of the story?
units.italian: Avete incontrato la Coalizione, e gli Heliarch che governano il loro spazio dall'interno dei mondi ad anello che i Quarg hanno costruito laggiù, e che affermano di avere "sconfitto gli oppressori Quarg". Volete cercare qualche Quarg qui e chiedere la loro versione della storia?

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Early|	(Yes.)|267|0
units.english: (Yes.)
units.italian: (Sì.)

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Early|	(No.)|268|0
units.english: (No.)
units.italian: (No.)

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Early|	You stop the first Quarg that passes by you, and ask if they could tell their side of the story about the Coalition.|270|0
units.english: You stop the first Quarg that passes by you, and ask if they could tell their side of the story about the Coalition.
units.italian: Fermate il primo Quarg che vi passa accanto e chiedete se può raccontare la sua versione della storia sulla Coalizione.

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Early|	"Ah, so you have encountered the foolish Coalition," it begins. "They once were three promising species, before they succumbed to the unwise desire for usurpation of the great deeds of others.|271|0
units.english: "Ah, so you have encountered the foolish Coalition," it begins. "They once were three promising species, before they succumbed to the unwise desire for usurpation of the great deeds of others.
units.italian: "Ah, dunque hai incontrato la stolta Coalizione," comincia. "Un tempo erano tre specie promettenti, prima di cedere al desiderio insensato di usurpare le grandi imprese altrui.

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Early|	"Not that all of them are petty thieves, but sadly the civilization they have become is now ruled by a fanatical military, as I am sure you have seen, having spoken with those wretched Heliarchs."|272|0
units.english: "Not that all of them are petty thieves, but sadly the civilization they have become is now ruled by a fanatical military, as I am sure you have seen, having spoken with those wretched Heliarchs."
units.italian: "Non che siano tutti ladruncoli, ma purtroppo la civiltà che sono diventati è ora governata da un esercito fanatico, come di certo hai visto, avendo parlato con quei miseri Heliarch."

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Early|	"Is it true that they defeated you?"|274|0
units.english: "Is it true that they defeated you?"
units.italian: "È vero che vi hanno sconfitti?"

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Early|	"Is it true what they told me? That you oppressed them and hindered their development?"|276|0
units.english: "Is it true what they told me? That you oppressed them and hindered their development?"
units.italian: "È vero quello che mi hanno raccontato? Che li opprimevate e ostacolavate il loro sviluppo?"

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Early|	It clicks its teeth together for a moment, and frowns a bit. "Do not underestimate us, human. We are numerous, and we are strong." It pauses for a moment, with a blank expression on its face, as if trying to remember something. "We just know better than to slaughter billions for the sake of maintaining our position."|279|0
units.english: It clicks its teeth together for a moment, and frowns a bit. "Do not underestimate us, human. We are numerous, and we are strong." It pauses for a moment, with a blank expression on its face, as if trying to remember something. "We just know better than to slaughter billions for the sake of maintaining our position."
units.italian: Fa scattare i denti l'uno contro l'altro per un momento e si acciglia un po'. "Non sottovalutarci, umano. Siamo numerosi, e siamo forti." Si ferma un momento, con un'espressione vuota sul viso, come se cercasse di ricordare qualcosa. "Sappiamo solo che è meglio non massacrare miliardi di esseri per mantenere la nostra posizione."

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Early|	"Of course not. Have you seen us do such things with humanity? Or with any other alien species you might have reached in your travels with a jump drive? The Heliarchs, like any other fanatical military, merely fabricated an excuse to justify attacking us."|282|0
units.english: "Of course not. Have you seen us do such things with humanity? Or with any other alien species you might have reached in your travels with a jump drive? The Heliarchs, like any other fanatical military, merely fabricated an excuse to justify attacking us."
units.italian: "Certo che no. Ci hai visto fare cose simili con l'umanità? O con qualche altra specie aliena che tu possa aver raggiunto nei tuoi viaggi con un motore a salto? Gli Heliarch, come qualsiasi altro esercito fanatico, si sono inventati una scusa per giustificare l'attacco contro di noi."

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Early|	Before you can ask it anything else, the Quarg bids you farewell, and walks away.|284|0
units.english: Before you can ask it anything else, the Quarg bids you farewell, and walks away.
units.italian: Prima che possiate chiedergli altro, il Quarg vi saluta e si allontana.

units.id: mission:Quarg Pug Arfecta Warning|As soon as you land, you see a crowd of Quarg gathering around one of your escorts, the Pug Arfecta. The captain of the ship looks shaken as the Quarg surround them, seemingly being questioned by a rather tall Quarg, even by Quarg standards. The captain looks around and, seeing you, points in your direction, causing the Quarg to come your way. The tall Quarg towers over you and gives you a piercing stare.|302|0
units.english: As soon as you land, you see a crowd of Quarg gathering around one of your escorts, the Pug Arfecta. The captain of the ship looks shaken as the Quarg surround them, seemingly being questioned by a rather tall Quarg, even by Quarg standards. The captain looks around and, seeing you, points in your direction, causing the Quarg to come your way. The tall Quarg towers over you and gives you a piercing stare.
units.italian: Appena atterrate, vedete una folla di Quarg radunarsi intorno a una delle vostre scorte, il Pug Arfecta. Il capitano della nave sembra scosso mentre i Quarg lo circondano e un Quarg piuttosto alto, anche per gli standard Quarg, sembra interrogarlo. Il capitano si guarda intorno e, vedendo voi, vi indica, facendo sì che il Quarg venga verso di voi. Il Quarg alto torreggia su di voi e vi fissa con uno sguardo penetrante.

units.id: mission:Quarg Pug Arfecta Warning|As soon as you land your ship, a crowd of Quarg start to gather around. As you go to disembark, you find a rather imposing Quarg blocking the exit. Tall even by Quarg standards, it towers over you and gives you a piercing stare.|305|0
units.english: As soon as you land your ship, a crowd of Quarg start to gather around. As you go to disembark, you find a rather imposing Quarg blocking the exit. Tall even by Quarg standards, it towers over you and gives you a piercing stare.
units.italian: Appena atterrate con la nave, una folla di Quarg comincia a radunarsi. Mentre scendete, trovate un Quarg piuttosto imponente che vi blocca l'uscita. Alto anche per gli standard Quarg, torreggia su di voi e vi fissa con uno sguardo penetrante.

units.id: mission:Quarg Pug Arfecta Warning|	"It is as though a baby in swaddling has tamed a dragon and now rides it through the sky spewing fire with reckless abandon," it says while not breaking its gaze, unblinking.|307|0
units.english: "It is as though a baby in swaddling has tamed a dragon and now rides it through the sky spewing fire with reckless abandon," it says while not breaking its gaze, unblinking.
units.italian: "È come se un bambino in fasce avesse addomesticato un drago e ora lo cavalcasse per il cielo sputando fuoco con abbandono sconsiderato," dice senza distogliere lo sguardo, senza battere ciglio.

units.id: mission:Quarg Pug Arfecta Warning|	"It's a long story..."|309|0
units.english: "It's a long story..."
units.italian: "È una storia lunga..."

units.id: mission:Quarg Pug Arfecta Warning|	"It was an act of righteous defiance."|311|0
units.english: "It was an act of righteous defiance."
units.italian: "È stato un atto di giusta ribellione."

units.id: mission:Quarg Pug Arfecta Warning|	"The Pug fancy themselves gods, but since God is dead..."|313|0
units.english: "The Pug fancy themselves gods, but since God is dead..."
units.italian: "I Pug si credono dèi, ma dal momento che Dio è morto..."

units.id: mission:Quarg Pug Arfecta Warning|	"I saw something I liked, so I made it mine."|315|0
units.english: "I saw something I liked, so I made it mine."
units.italian: "Ho visto qualcosa che mi piaceva, e me la sono presa."

units.id: mission:Quarg Pug Arfecta Warning|	It scoffs, "It matters not how it happened.|318|0
units.english: It scoffs, "It matters not how it happened.
units.italian: Sbuffa: "Non importa come sia successo.

units.id: mission:Quarg Pug Arfecta Warning|	"You fancy yourself a savior or a revolutionary then?" the Quarg says with what you assume is a sarcastic tone.|321|0
units.english: "You fancy yourself a savior or a revolutionary then?" the Quarg says with what you assume is a sarcastic tone.
units.italian: "Allora ti credi un salvatore o un rivoluzionario?" dice il Quarg con quello che immaginate sia un tono sarcastico.

units.id: mission:Quarg Pug Arfecta Warning|	"So you deign to prove them wrong?" the Quarg says with an almost amused, or perhaps incredulous tone.|324|0
units.english: "So you deign to prove them wrong?" the Quarg says with an almost amused, or perhaps incredulous tone.
units.italian: "Quindi ti degni di dimostrare che si sbagliano?" dice il Quarg con un tono quasi divertito, o forse incredulo.

units.id: mission:Quarg Pug Arfecta Warning|	"A baby in swaddling, indeed...|327|0
units.english: "A baby in swaddling, indeed...
units.italian: "Un bambino in fasce, davvero...

units.id: mission:Quarg Pug Arfecta Warning|	"We give you a warning. You know not what you have, human - what weapon you wield.|330|0
units.english: "We give you a warning. You know not what you have, human - what weapon you wield.
units.italian: "Vi diamo un avvertimento. Non sapete cosa avete, umano - quale arma impugnate.

units.id: mission:Quarg Pug Arfecta Warning|	"We have seen its power. We have felt it, and learned from it. But you and your kind know nothing of the burdens and dangers that follow it. Be careful that you are the one who directs this power, and not it you.|331|0
units.english: "We have seen its power. We have felt it, and learned from it. But you and your kind know nothing of the burdens and dangers that follow it. Be careful that you are the one who directs this power, and not it you.
units.italian: "Ne abbiamo visto il potere. L'abbiamo sentito, e ne abbiamo imparato. Ma voi e la vostra specie non sapete nulla dei fardelli e dei pericoli che ne seguono. Fate attenzione a essere voi a dirigere questo potere, e non lui a dirigere voi.

units.id: mission:Quarg Pug Arfecta Warning|	"Know well that we have learned how to overcome it."|332|0
units.english: "Know well that we have learned how to overcome it."
units.italian: "Sappi bene che abbiamo imparato a superarlo."

units.id: mission:Quarg Pug Arfecta Warning|	The Quarg takes one last long look at your ship, then makes a curt farewell motion, leaving you to your business. The crowd, too, starts to disperse, with only a few staying behind to gawk at the ship.|333|0
units.english: The Quarg takes one last long look at your ship, then makes a curt farewell motion, leaving you to your business. The crowd, too, starts to disperse, with only a few staying behind to gawk at the ship.
units.italian: Il Quarg dà un ultimo lungo sguardo alla vostra nave, poi fa un breve cenno di commiato, lasciandovi ai vostri affari. Anche la folla comincia a disperdersi, e solo pochi restano a fissare la nave a bocca aperta.

units.id: mission:Quarg Pug Arfecta Warning|	As you make your way through the ring, you notice occasional glares from the Quarg onboard the ring.|334|0
units.english: As you make your way through the ring, you notice occasional glares from the Quarg onboard the ring.
units.italian: Mentre attraversate l'anello, notate occasionali sguardi torvi da parte dei Quarg a bordo.
